title: Host Capability Descriptor
description: Static, Core-owned description of one host capability in the projection registry. The registry is not runtime-extensible; this schema documents the descriptor shape.

id.description: Stable dotted capability id, e.g. host.app.open-resource.

resultPolicy.description: Host->guest result channel type. host.app.open-resource is none (fire-and-forget).

residualPolicy.description: Effect ownership after the response. external-unmanaged is a handoff, not a managed Hideout resource.

status.description: design-ready descriptors exist to prove the model accommodates the full vision and MUST fail closed if dispatched.
